transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: I’m in the mobile app. I need last year’s broker report and want to see where the pricing plan is printed in it.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Hello! I'm AIM, the Freedom Broker AI assistant. I can answer questions about products and services, provide information about your accounts, assets and fees, compare information in a table, share your account manager's contact details, and pass your question to our support team.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: By continuing this conversation, you agree to the collection and processing of your personal data and confirm that you have read the company's Privacy Policy.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: The pricing plan is on the first page of the broker report.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Could you connect me with an agent? I can't find the report menu.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Would you like me to connect you with an agent?

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: yes please

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Please wait. An agent will join the chat shortly.

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.text: Chat transferred to an agent.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Jordan. In the app, open Menu, then Reports and Documents, then Broker Report. Select last year's dates and download the report.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Got it. Which part of the first page should I look at?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Look in Account Information on the first page. That's where the pricing plan is listed.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Okay, and if I only want the current plan next time, can I see it without downloading anything?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Yes. In the web version, open the account area, labelled «Кабинет» in the Russian interface. The current plan is under your name.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: That answers both questions. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: The report opened on my phone. I was looking at the balance page earlier, so I just want to make sure this is the right document.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Check the document title. If it says Broker Report, you're in the right document. The plan is in Account Information on page one.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Yes, it says Broker Report. There are two downloads, though. I think one is from the wrong year.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Use the one for the dates you selected for last year. You can go back to Broker Report and generate it again if you're unsure which file you opened.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Found it now. I was opening the wrong download.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: You're welcome. You have the report and know where to check the current plan. Goodbye!
